product.title: Dublin to Glendalough, Wicklow and Kilkenny Full Day Guided Tour

description.text: Leave Dublin on a 9-hour 15-minute coach day through Wicklow Mountains National Park, Glendalough, and Kilkenny. A guide and separate driver cover The Wicklow Gap viewpoints, monastic ruins at Glendalough Monastic Settlement, and a walking circuit of Kilkenny Castle and medieval streets. Free time in Kilkenny lets the group add lunch or independent sightseeing before the return. The outing is built for visitors who want Wicklow scenery and a medieval city in one Dublin-based day. Stops include Glendalough Monastic Settlement, Wicklow Mountains National Park, The Wicklow Gap, Kilkenny Castle.
